title: Set the loan period for power tools
body:
# Set the loan period for power tools

## Context
Members keep asking how long a drill or a saw may stay out.

## Decision
A member may keep a power tool for 6 days, and the desk volunteer writes the due date on the loan card.

## Consequences
Tools come back before the weekend rush.

title: Keep a wipe-down step on every tool return
body:
# Keep a wipe-down step on every tool return

## Context
Sawdust and grease left on a returned tool wear it out.

## Decision
A power tool is lent for 4 days and must be wiped down before it goes back on the shelf. The desk volunteer signs the tool back in on the return sheet.

## Consequences
Tools stay clean and the return sheet shows who handled each one.

title: Tool desk
body:
# Tool desk

The desk is where members sign tools in and out. The loan rules are set in decision/set-the-loan-period-for-power-tools. Members borrow a power tool for 4 days; the desk opens at ten on weekdays. A volunteer staffs the desk and keeps the loan cards in the green box.

title: Check the drill batteries when a loan comes back
body:
# Check the drill batteries when a loan comes back

Test each drill battery when a loan comes back, and put flat ones on the charger. Leave a note on the return sheet for any battery that will not hold a charge.
